name: Sonoma Coast SP
description: Sonoma Coast State Park is a series of beaches from Bodega Bay to the Russian River with coves, headlands, natural arches, tide pools, and some of the best winter whale watching in California.
fullDescription: Sonoma Coast State Park is a series of beaches from Bodega Bay to the Russian River with coves, headlands, natural arches, tide pools, and some of the best winter whale watching in California.
whatTheyOffer:
- Beaches, tide pools, fishing, and whale watching
- Hiking and horseback riding trails
- Tent, RV, hike-and-bike, and environmental campsites (reserve at ReserveCalifornia.com)
- Dogs allowed on specific beaches only
howToGetIt:
- Vehicle day use: $10
- Camping: reserve at ReserveCalifornia.com
- Park phone: (707) 875-3483

**Passes accepted at this park:**
- **California State Library Parks Pass**: Free vehicle day use; check one out from your public library
- **Golden Bear Pass**: Free vehicle day use for income-eligible Californians
- **Senior Golden Bear Pass**: $20/year for ages 62+ (not valid in peak season)
- **Disabled Discount Pass**: 50% off vehicle day use and camping
- **Distinguished Veteran Pass**: Free vehicle day use and camping for eligible veterans
keywords: Sonoma Coast, state park, Bodega Bay, beaches, hiking, coastal, camping, whale watching, rock formations
